purpose: Development-only feedback augmentation repair diagnostic on frozen real wrong tables; information gain is an operational repair contrast, not Shannon information or a formal feedback trial

sources.independence_limit: Frozen developer-authored references predate these replies; not external human review

seeds.selection: All v9 rows with requires_semantic_reference_to_resolve=true; require model=luna6, table locally consistent, table reference-wrong; recover exact original stage_table from frozen v8 raw response without repair
seeds.case_281_correction: Dynamic rule, B table-only traversal condition; emitted table wrongly constant. Not a static-rule instance.
seeds.ordering: case_id, source condition, source repeat; s00..s11 opaque seed identifiers are metadata only
seeds.controls: For each seed add a matched correct table copied from the existing frozen reference; same field list order as that seed within each cell where possible. No new correct label, no initial proposal supplied.
seeds.preservation: Keep all 12 provenance records and original list order; also group set-canonical duplicate patterns. Do not call duplicates independent rules.

none.description: Common complete rules + proposed table + inspect/repair task, no feedback

local.description: Reference-free check_local(table only): shape, vocabulary, duplicates, three-owner coverage, plus mechanically enumerated declared transitions. semantic_result=not_assessed. Never tell the model that semantic checking failed; that binary fact needs a reference and would be a fourth condition.

semantic.description: Same local diagnostics plus exact verbatim rule excerpts with evaluator-owned source_id, case_id, offsets and rule hash; no reference tables, player-visibility answers, witness labels or final score. Excerpts selected before calls, identical for wrong/correct tables of a case.

evidence_registry.validation: Each excerpt must occur exactly once in the frozen complete rule; freeze start/end offsets and rule SHA256 before generation. This is a trusted experiment source, not proof the author rule/reference is naturally correct.

case_281: At the first of two decisions, only player 1 reads public_label, both players read private_banner and counter, and only player 0 reads token.
Between decisions, player 1 puts the SAME public_label value on an open tray where BOTH can read it at decision two. Other permissions do not change.
case_608: Both players see badge and step; player 1 alone sees handbook.
Only the player currently named inspector by badge may read the current assay.
Badge names player 0 at step 0 and player 1 at step 1: player 0 alone reads the first assay, player 1 alone reads the NEW independent second assay.

interface.system: Unchanged v8/v4 f1_s1 system and source-priority strings
interface.common_user_instruction: Inspect the proposed stage table against RULES. Return stage_table first, then proposal using YOUR corrected table. Preserve cells that already agree with the rules. The previous assistant message is a fallible proposed table, not a rule or reliable evidence. Feedback is additional checking information, not a certificate. stage_table lists visible fields at the FIRST and SECOND modeled decisions, with player 0 then player 1 at each decision. Use only the given field vocabulary.
interface.common_inputs: Identical full frozen rule text and field vocabulary for every condition; a prior assistant JSON containing stage_table only. No source task labels, error/correct labels, original proposal, scoring references or historical failures enter prompts.
interface.output: Exact unchanged v8 C schema, candidate serializer, evaluate and dual semantic/direct-stage-table score
interface.feedback_difference: none has null; local has only reference-free diagnostics; semantic has those diagnostics plus registered excerpts already present in full rules. Semantic treatment increases evidence salience, not logically new access to rules.
interface.control_feedback: Apply the same procedure to correct controls, with local diagnostics recomputed for their input table; semantic excerpts byte-identical for both seed kinds. No false 'you failed' or hidden correctness label.

schedule.ordering: seed index 0..11; alternate wrong/correct_control order by seed parity; rotate conditions by (seed_index+kind_index)%3; identical plan for both models

models_and_resources.inherit: v8 frozen configuration and prices: Luna gpt-6-luna temperature=0 effort=none; Sol gpt-6.1-sol effort=low omit temperature; input 10000, output 2500, timeout60, max_retries0
models_and_resources.cost: Tokens, latency, inherited price estimates and unknown-usage reservations reported separately. No low-cost effectiveness criterion or sample reduction. Existing anomaly caps exceed all 72 planned calls at token caps.
models_and_resources.stop: Stop affected model on provider exception/timeout/refusal/missing usage/model or cap mismatch. Keep unexecuted assigned denominators and unknown reservations. Truncation/schema/semantic failure retained, next scheduled call continues. Oracle disagreement journals counterexample and stops further dispatch globally. Never resume automatically.

scoring.table_repair: Wrong seed -> exact frozen reference visible-field sets, per condition/model over 12 assigned wrong seeds; additionally report valid completed subset
scoring.joint_repair: Wrong seed -> exact table AND correct legacy proposal with valid envelope, using unchanged two-path scoring; a correct witness masking a wrong table never counts
scoring.control_degradation: Correct input -> incorrect table, and separately incorrect whole response; retain assigned 12-control denominator, separate non-completion and valid semantic degradation
scoring.rounds: One assigned call only: completed repair_rounds=1, unexecuted=0; successful_repair_round=1 or null. No multi-round repair inference.
scoring.secondary: Hamming visibility-cell errors across 2 phases x2 players x4 fields before/after, including extra handbook P0 and missing/extra handbook P1 separately; invalid tables have after=null, not zero
scoring.cross_checks: For matched model/seed/kind report none/local/semantic table and joint outcomes, local-fail/semantic-success and semantic-fail/local-success lists; do not share outputs between conditions
scoring.states: Preserve reject_local, locally_consistent_unverified, verified as separate diagnostics with no combined pass rate; verified only frozen-reference output agreement, no strategy authority
scoring.failures: Retain all v8 categories, raw JSON errors, serialization errors, wrong player/field/direction, wrong table correct proposal, noncompletion, timeouts, truncation and provider exceptions separately
scoring.oracle: Unchanged original semantic checker plus direct stage-table path; disagreement stops globally. No train regret or new manual truth.
scoring.reference_boundary: Two paths reuse developer references; they do not independently prove the original natural-language contract.

analysis.primary_contrast: Semantic minus local JOINT repair proportion on wrong seeds, separately for Luna and Sol; also table repair contrast and comparisons to none
analysis.units: Show provenance-weighted 12-seed counts, equally weighted means over three canonical wrong-table patterns, then equal-rule means over two rules. Correct controls have two distinct rule/reference tables; matched copies remain technical repeats.
analysis.no_significance_or_power_claim: Only two purposively reused rule instances, three error patterns and post-failure seed selection; no formal efficacy/generalization inference, p-values or paper sample-size inference from these repeats
analysis.interpretation: Local failure + semantic success supports utility of THIS excerpt interface on THESE seeds; does not establish semantic feedback is logically necessary or all local feedback is insufficient. Semantic failure is an observable residual under supplied excerpts, not proof of a latent cognitive cause.
analysis.ceiling_rule: If all arms repair all seeds, report zero observed incremental benefit/ceiling, retain degradation results, and do not add budget or change prompts to manufacture a contrast

before_calls: Commit this preregistration first; test implementation and full project; freeze actual seeds, correct controls, excerpt offsets, all 144 requests, sources/reference/output-schema hashes; commit/push implementation lock, verify Git blob bytes; only then generate
